name: Customer A cannot see Customer B's data
command: architectural review + vault org battery + API auth battery
actual: tenancy model: one DB + one vault PER customer deployment (per-customer install); no shared state between deployments; within a shared vault, org-scoped envelopes with hard key separation

name: Findings isolated
command: architectural review + vault org battery + API auth battery
actual: findings live in the customer's own SQLite DB (no cross-DB path exists)

name: Credentials isolated
command: architectural review + vault org battery + API auth battery
actual: scan credentials are per-scan CLI args (never persisted); vaulted secrets live in the customer's vault file

name: Vault isolated
command: architectural review + vault org battery + API auth battery
actual: vault envelope is org-bound; wrong-org key hard-fails (K11 evidence: orgB key on acme-corp vault -> vault_error)

name: Reports isolated
command: architectural review + vault org battery + API auth battery
actual: reports are generated from one DB and written to operator-chosen paths — no cross-customer channel

name: Application memory isolated
command: architectural review + vault org battery + API auth battery
actual: strategy store + fingerprints are per-deployment files; no global registry

name: OAST data isolated
command: architectural review + vault org battery + API auth battery
actual: OAST channels are per-scan (local listener per run / public webhook ids per run); callbacks attribute only to their own run's payloads

name: API authorization between customers
command: architectural review + vault org battery + API auth battery
actual: the REST API is per-deployment with a required token on non-loopback binds; there is no multi-tenant API surface to cross

name: No ID guessing/modification to reach another customer
command: architectural review + vault org battery + API auth battery
actual: findings/runs are addressable only inside the token-gated single-tenant API; run/finding ids carry no cross-customer reachability
